race.comment: JUST MY LOT (14) broke through for a dominant maiden win last start at Hamilton, stepping up to the mile and bolting in by over five lengths as the short-priced favourite. Drawn wide and up in grade but can go on with it. CROSSOVERKID (16) has just found one better in both runs this time in. Comes off a let-up here but goes well here and should get a cosy run from the inside gate. GOVERNOR KING (4) is mixing form a bit. Comes back in trip but best form is good enough. HAIIRO (2) resumes. He won first up last time in at Kilmore in easier company but did go on to run in a VRC St Leger. He can run well here on his home track. HILL CRY (10) has won two of her past three and should figure again.
